```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
library(ggmap)
library(lubridate)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
``` 

```{r}
microplastics <- read.csv("fish_microplastics.csv")
```

```{r}
microplastics <- microplastics %>%
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
microplastics %>%
  glimpse()%>%
  names() 
```

```{r}
microplastics  %>%
  gg_miss_var()
```
```{r}
register_stadiamaps("280bdc76-265c-4420-af16-f3fc7ab98211", write = FALSE)
```

```{r}
microplastics %>%
  select(collection_lat, collection_long) %>%
  summary()
```

```{r}
lat <- c(27, 27.75)
long <- c(-83, -82)
bbox <- make_bbox(long, lat, f= 0.03)
unique(microplastics$collection_long)
```

```{r}
map_fish <- get_stadiamap(bbox, maptype = "stamen_terrain", zoom = 7)
```

```{r}
ggmap(map_fish) +
  geom_point(data = microplastics, aes(collection_long, collection_lat), size = 2, , alpha = 0.8)+ 
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", title = "Collection Locations")
```
